correctness.rationale: Headline s_{E2}(0)=2/sqrt(5) proved analytically. Lower bound: L(z)=tz with t=2/sqrt(5) satisfies |Lz|^2=t^2(x+y)<t^2(1+1/4)=1 on x+y^2<1 via y-y^2<=1/4, and B^2 subset E2 gives B(0,t) subset L(E). Envelope sup_E|z|^2=5/4 at (3/4,1/2) verified by 1+y-y^2<=5/4. Domain facts (balanced, B^2 subset E2, smooth boundary, convex via Hessian diag(2,2,4sI+8vv') eigenvalues 4s,12s>=0, type exactly 4 via Levi |v1|^2+4|p2|^2|v2|^2 and tangential expansion with K=|v2|^4>0 forcing contact <=4 attained by (1,zeta)) all checked. Lemma R (K_E(0,v)=m(v) via admissible disc + Hahn-Banach supporting functional + Schwarz; ball formula; metric-decreasing B(0,r) subset f(E) subset B^2 gives |Av|<=m(v)<=|Av|/r, hence A=df0 satisfies A(E) subset B^2 and B(0,r) subset A(E), rank 2 so iso) is correct subject only to standard facts (injective holomorphic => everywhere-invertible differential/ biholomorphism onto open image; complex Hahn-Banach for Minkowski seminorm; K_{B(0,r)}(0,w)=|w|/r). Lemma M (phase elimination to diag(a,b) via r^2=min(px^2+qy^2-2|c|xy), constraint max(px^2+qy^2+2|c|xy)<=1; diagonal B(0,r) subset D(E) iff r<=min(a,b) via convex h(s)=s/a^2+(r^2-s)^2/b^4 with h''>0; outer max g(u)=a^2(1-u^2)+b^2u concave, max 5t^2/4 at u=1/2, asymmetric cases g(1/2)>=5min^2/4) forces r<=2/sqrt(5), attained by tI via B^2 subset E2. Assembly gives matching bounds. Script scaling_check.py ALL CHECKS PASSED is corroboration only; proof does not depend on numerics. Preset 1/sqrt(2) correctly refuted since 2/sqrt(5)>1/sqrt(2).

originality.rationale: EMERGENT_FINDING route: claim 2/sqrt(5) for ordinary squeezing at origin of |z1|^2+|z2|^4<1 not in surveyed priors and not mechanically implied. Nearest priors compared substantively: Deng-Guan-Zhang 1109.3920 (HHR/gaps for convex/strongly pseudoconvex, no type-m c(m), no E2 value); Joo-Kim 1611.08356 and Ninh et al. 2509.10774 / Van Thu 2209.14168 (limit-1 forces strong pseudoconvexity / boundary behaviour, opposite direction, compatible with but not implying interior exact value); Van Thu et al. 2005.00977 (general ellipsoid WB-domain HHR + uniform bound near (P,r)-extreme point, one-sided/local only); Bharali-Borah-Gorai 2305.11145 (exact constant for bounded symmetric domains extending Kubota, different non-symmetric family); Gumenyuk-Roth 2011.13734 / Ng-Tang-Tsai (exact values only for annuli/planar); Gupta-Pant 2211.14971 (generalized squeezing of BALL w.r.t. product models 1/sqrt(k), different invariant/domain direction). Independent arXiv queries (Thullen: 14 hits on Bergman/Cheng-Yau/Cartan-Thullen, none on squeezing; squeezing+ellipsoid/Thullen title search 0 hits; squeezing-function exact-value hits only annuli/quantum) confirm absence. Constant 2/sqrt(5) with saturator (|z1|,|z2|)=(sqrt(3)/2,1/sqrt(2)) and Lemma R+M proof are new at triage level; internal prior scan (20 resultary, 20 failed) has no squeezing result.

value.rationale: EMERGENT_FINDING with no preset-value presumption; passes ordinary exact-invariant standard. E2={(z1,z2):|z1|^2+|z2|^4<1} is a named natural object (smallest non-strictly-pseudoconvex decoupled finite-type model, D'Angelo type 4) motivated before computation as calibration endpoint of Deng-Guan-Zhang uniformity / Catlin-D'Angelo / Fridman / Kobayashi program (topic motivation, audit_plan model-domain step). Invariant s_{E2}(0) was not known, is not mechanically implied by one-sided ellipsoid bounds or symmetric/annulus formulas or opposite-direction generalized squeezing, and a future researcher testing any c(4) bound over a class containing E2 or citing a scaling-limit endpoint reasonably needs the precise fact (benchmark c(4)<=2/sqrt(5)). Rigorously established two-sided exact value, not textbook restatement, parameter substitution, tiny gain, or unexplained enumeration. Scope honestly limited to origin only (DRAFT Sec 6), no inf_E claim. Genuinely arose from target investigation (target's own model-computation step carried to exactness after unconditional horns stalled and preset 1/sqrt(2) proved false with >=2/sqrt(5) embedding), not a convenient replacement; absence from topic.json not adverse.
